events.title: Intro to ArcGIS Pro Workshop- State Employees
events.description: Introduction to ArcGIS Pro is a hands-on workshop designed specifically for Missouri state employees who are new to Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or looking to build foundational skills in Esri’s ArcGIS Pro software. This training provides practical experience with core GIS concepts and tools used to support data-driven decision-making across state agencies. Participants will explore the ArcGIS Pro interface and learn how to create, manage, and visualize spatial data. The workshop also covers basic mapping techniques and introductory spatial analysis, along with practical skills for producing clear and effective map products used in government workflows and reporting. No prior GIS experience is required. All software, equipment, and training materials will be provided.

events.description: Introduction to ArcGIS Pro is a hands-on workshop designed specifically for Missouri state employees who are new to Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or looking to build foundational skills in Esri’s ArcGIS Pro software. This training provides practical experience with core GIS concepts and tools used to support data-driven decision-making across state agencies. Participants will explore the ArcGIS Pro interface and learn how to create, manage, and visualize spatial data. The workshop also covers basic mapping techniques and introductory spatial analysis, along with practical skills for producing clear and effective map products used in government workflows and reporting. No prior GIS experience is required. All software, equipment, and training materials will be provided.

events.title: Intro to Spatial Analysis Workshop- State Employees
events.description: This 4-hour workshop introduces the fundamentals of spatial analysis using ArcGIS Pro. Designed for professionals with some prior GIS experience, the course focuses on developing practical skills for framing spatial questions, selecting appropriate analytical methods, and applying ArcGIS Pro tools to solve real-world problems.
